full.description: This is a gross pathology specimen of the lungs viewed from the anterior aspect, showing the trachea and major bronchi extending centrally between the lobes. The lung parenchyma appears congested and firm, consistent with diffuse alveolar damage. The surfaces show extensive hemorrhagic and edematous changes throughout the tissue. This presentation is characteristic of acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) associated with diffuse alveolar damage.
